description: Use this when the user wants a cap table calculator or startup dilution calculator: a pro-forma cap table before and after post-money or pre-money SAFEs, convertible notes (principal plus simple interest, cap, discount) and/or a priced round (pre-money valuation, new money, target option pool topped up in the pre-money). Returns price per share, each instrument's cap price, discount price and conversion price (the lower), shares issued, each holder's fully diluted % before and after, an Excel cap table and a PDF summary. Solves the circular pool and conversion math with fractions, then rounds to whole shares. Illustrative only; does not model liquidation preferences, vesting, anti-dilution or more than one priced round, and is not legal or tax advice.

company_name.description: Company name for the files, e.g. "Acme Robotics".

currency.description: ISO currency code for labels, default USD, e.g. EUR.

kind.description: common (founders, employees; default), options (granted options), pool (unallocated option pool), preferred (prior priced rounds) or warrant. Guessed from the name when left out: a name with "pool" is the unallocated pool.

name.description: Holder name, e.g. "Alice (founder)", "Option pool" or "Seed investors".

shares.description: Shares or options held, fully diluted, e.g. 4000000 or "4M".

holders.description: Current holders with shares, fully diluted, including granted options and the unallocated pool. Array, e.g. [{"name":"Alice","shares":4500000},{"name":"Bob","shares":4500000},{"name":"Option pool","shares":1000000,"kind":"pool"}], or text "Alice 4.5M; Bob 4.5M; Option pool 1M".

conversion_date.description: Conversion date, e.g. 2026-06-30. Default: the round date, else today (America/New_York).

interest_rate.description: Simple annual interest in percent, e.g. 6 for 6%.

issue_date.description: Date the note was issued, e.g. 2025-03-01. Interest accrues from here to conversion_date (actual days / 365).

valuation_cap.description: Valuation cap, e.g. 6000000. Cap price = cap / fully diluted shares before the round (excluding converting securities and the new pool).

date.description: Closing date, used as the note conversion date, e.g. 2026-06-30.

amount.description: Amount invested in the round, e.g. 3000000.

investors.description: Optional split of new money by investor, e.g. [{"name":"Lead","amount":4000000},{"name":"Angels","amount":1000000}].

new_money.description: New cash invested in the round, e.g. 5000000 or "$5M". Not counting SAFEs or notes converting.

post_money_valuation.description: Instead of pre_money_valuation: post-money valuation, e.g. 25000000 (pre = post - new money).

pre_money_valuation.description: Pre-money valuation of the priced round, e.g. 20000000 or "$20M". Includes the pool top-up and the conversions (standard term sheet convention).

target_pool_percent.description: Unallocated option pool target after the round, in percent of post-money fully diluted shares, e.g. 10. The top-up is in the pre-money (the pool shuffle).

round.description: The priced round. Leave out to see ownership with SAFEs converted at their caps only.

discount.description: Discount in percent, e.g. 20 for 20% (a YC "discount rate" of 80% is read as a 20% discount).

mfn.description: true for an MFN SAFE: it takes the lowest cap and highest discount of SAFEs listed after it.

name.description: Investor or SAFE label, e.g. "Angel SAFE".

type.description: post (YC post-money SAFE, default) or pre (pre-money SAFE).

valuation_cap.description: Valuation cap, e.g. 8000000 or "$8M". Post-money cap unless type is pre.

safes.description: SAFEs to convert, e.g. [{"name":"Angels","amount":500000,"valuation_cap":8000000,"discount":20}] or text "$500k at $8M post cap 20% discount; $250k MFN".

name: calculate_cap_table
title: Calculate cap table
